provider: 115 and Google team-drive rentals (the resale market)

free_tier.stated: not a free tier: a rented Google team drive at CNY 20 per month, six months minimum, with unlimited space, a 400,000-file cap and a 750 GB per day upload cap

per_object_cap.stated: 400,000 files per drive, stated by the seller

retention.stated: the drive lasts as long as the underlying tenant does; the seller states no refund if the plan disappears, and one thread carries a buyer reporting that the drive vanished

egress.terms: downloads are stated as unlimited by one seller; uploads are capped at 750 GB per day per drive

tooling: a Google Drive API client or rclone; the rental is a permission on a shared drive, not a new protocol
chaining: the cheapest route to a pooled tenant that already exists, and the clearest evidence that an 'unlimited' Google quota is a quota being arbitraged by somebody else

limits.value: 750 GB per day upload per drive; 2.5 TB per day for a whole rented domain

identity_cost.detail: CNY 20 per month, six months minimum, paid to an individual seller; the identity gate is the payment, not a registration

reliability_note: The underlying tenant is the failure point and the renter does not control it: one thread's own replies describe unlimited Workspace space as a bug-based expansion, and another carries a buyer reporting that the team drive vanished. No refund on a mid-term exit is stated in every listing read.

evidence.proved: a seller offers '20 元/月，半年起租', '无限空间，单盘最多 40 万个文件', '每天上传额度 750 GB', and a whole rented domain at '每个域每天上传额度 2.5 TB' (posted 2026-10-04)
the same seller's earlier listing at the same price and the same caps, 110 days before, so the offer is repeatable and not a one-off (posted 2026-07-03)
a different seller at '月付20块，半年起付' with '文件个数40w个，每天上传流量750G，下载不限', which corroborates both caps independently (posted 2025-06-01)
a reply argues '200T的workspace都是卡bug扩容的', so at least one buyer believes the unlimited space is an expansion bug rather than a plan (posted 2026-07-13)

notes: Four listings on one forum between 2024-05 and 2026-10 quote CNY 15 to 20 per month for unlimited Google team-drive space with a 400,000-file cap and a 750 GB per day upload cap, and two of the threads argue about whether the space is a genuine plan or an expansion bug. Where a rental market exists, the underlying unlimited quota is being arbitraged, and the arbitrageur's account is what fails.
binding_note: The space is nominally unlimited and the file count is 400,000; what actually bounds a day's work is the 750 GB per day upload cap, and what bounds the arrangement is that the tenant belongs to somebody else.
confidence_note: the date on each evidence row is the day the post was read (2026-10-22); the post's own publication date is carried inside the proved string, because a forum post describes a moment and its age is a property of the claim and not of the reading
